Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                             ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the Cl-1 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11-K in the area bounded by

       West Lawrence Avenue; North Knox Avenue; the alley next south of and
       parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; a line 150 feet west of and parallel to
       North Knox Avenue

to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District is hereby
established in the area above described.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
 due publication.
